title: V-8 ENGINE "454" C.I.D. HI PERF.- RADIATOR SEALS
summary: LS5 454 radiator support foam seals (air dam / baffle seals around the radiator): the support-to-hood seal on top of the upper rail, upper and lower seals, and RH/LH side seals on the radiator support. Two push-in fasteners hold seals to the support; the other seals simply sit on the support flanges (no retention shown).

fastening.note: Push-in fastener [6] goes through LH seal [5] into a hole in the support side (dashed line).

fastening.to: radiator support upper rail, LH end
fastening.note: Second fastener [6] goes through the foam seal on the inner upper rail at the LH end; which callout that seal belongs to is not marked.

fastening.to: top of radiator support upper rail
fastening.note: Seal [1] runs along the top of the upper rail, sealing against the hood; retention not shown.
RH side seal [2] (dashed lines to the support RH side), upper seal [3] under the upper rail, lower seal [4] along the lower rail; no fastener or adhesive shown.

notes_internal: Item 1: hole punch covers middle digits; visible '3' + '92'. Assumed 7 digits.
Item 1 has a filled/half-filled circle symbol in the drawing.
Revision block blank; K359 in margin.
